# Hanan Irfan — Multidisciplinary Developer, SEO Specialist & Entrepreneur

> Official portfolio web application and Android TWA app of Abdul Hanan Irfan (Hanan Irfan), based in Rahim Yar Khan, Punjab, Pakistan.

Hanan Irfan is a 5th Semester BS Computer Science student at Khwaja Fareed University of Engineering and Information Technology (KFUEIT) with a 3.65 CGPA and Spring 2026 Dean's Honor Certificate. He serves as Founder & AI Developer of The Sports Room (co-founded with Urwah Farooq under HI Digital Group), Development Team Head at ACM KFUEIT, and Campus Ambassador of D'Educationist.
